A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FedOMG research. All 26 pages in each version, including Appendices A–F, are readable, and the methods, equations, experiments, tables and figures can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original toy-task simulations, FL and FDG benchmark experiments, ablations, computational measurements and CelebA evaluations in Section 6 and Appendices C–E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including benchmark comparisons, gradient-invariance analyses and the supplementary CelebA evaluation.

M1.justification: The local updates, gradient-combination objective, search-radius constraint, server optimization and integration with other methods are unchanged. Algorithm 1 and its update equations are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Rect-4, MNIST, EMNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, VLCS, PACS, OfficeHome and CelebA. The combined domain-shift/non-IID scenario in Appendix E.5 already appears in v1.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same FL/FDG baselines and OMG combinations. Tables 6–8 retain the centralized ERM, Fish and Fishr comparisons, and Figure 15 retains the same CelebA comparators in each panel.

E3.justification: The reported architectures, Dirichlet settings, client participation, training budgets, learning rates, batch sizes and evaluation metrics are unchanged. Appendix D.6 retains the same leave-one-domain-out protocol; changing its introductory description from FL to FDG does not change the settings.

E4.justification: The toy-task analysis, pretraining ablations, learning-rate and search-radius sensitivity studies, gradient-invariance diagnostics, local-training study and computational comparison retain the same questions and evidence. Figure 5's discussion is corrected without changing the analysis or plotted evidence.

E5.justification: Both retain five-run averaging in Table 1, three-run reporting for FDG and sensitivity experiments, and the same uncertainty displays. No seed information, confidence intervals or statistical testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Section 6.3 corrects the reported high-cosine FedAvg domain from C to S, matching Figure 5a in both PDFs. Numerical results and plotted curves are unchanged, including FedOMG's Table 2 averages of 82.0, 88.4 and 70.0 on VLCS, PACS and OfficeHome.

T1.justification: The mathematical objectives, assumptions, bounds and proofs remain unchanged. The explanation of sampled-domain notation added near Theorem 2 restates material already present in Appendix F.4; the expanded target-client index sequence is equivalent notation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same scientific contributions: data-free server gradient matching, no additional communication cost, integration with other methods, theoretical generalization analysis and improved FL/FDG performance.

C2.justification: The Figure 5 discussion changes the domain to which FedAvg may overfit from C (Cartoons) to S (Sketches). This corrects a specific interpretation; the broader gradient-invariance explanation and applicability qualifications remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 newly states that reproducible code is publicly available and supplies a repository link in footnote 1. v1 lacks this access information. The implementation descriptions and hyperparameters in the appendices remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to prior FL, FDG and gradient-matching methods are unchanged. Edits in Appendix A and elsewhere adjust citation formatting without adding or removing research references.

P1.justification: v2 changes the title's 'Gradient Matching' to 'Matching Gradient', edits affiliations and several sentences, adds acknowledgments and briefly explains sampling notation. Section order is retained. The added notation sentence contains a duplicated D_u subscript.

P2.justification: The same figures and tables remain, with unchanged plotted content and table structures. Text reflow shifts several displays and section boundaries; references begin on page 11 instead of page 10, and Table 4 receives minor label-formatting edits.

improvement.justification: v2 adds previously absent code-access information and corrects the Figure 5 discussion to agree with the plotted domain S curve. These provide limited improvements in reproducibility guidance and interpretive accuracy. The scientific evidence and proofs remain unchanged; the small new notation typo does not outweigh these gains.
